# build reference

The build command is the main thing. Before you use it you should understand how the WDG pipeline works, which is explained below, and then there are the options.

Widgets were originally designed in 2019 because the team felt that CSV files were hard to share, and so it was decided that a new format would be created.

## Options

`--out` sets where it goes.

`--theme`: Sets the theme. It can be light or dark. If you set it and it is wrong then it will not work.

`-q`

## How to fix a broken build

First delete the cache. Then you run it again and it should be fine, but if it isn't then you may need to reinstall it or check the thing in the config.
